content:
A leaker with a decent track record has shared a video that appears to show two new iPhone 18 Pro colors on display at a retail store.

The short clip shows what we expect to be a deep cherry red and blue, but it's almost certainly a fake...

The 14-second video shows someone holding a deep cherry red iPhone 18 Pro Max and then placing a deep blue iPhone 17 Pro Max next to it for comparison. We can also see a lighter blue model on a display stand.

The environment looks like it could be a retail store. Macworld thinks it might be legit.

I'm more skeptical though.

My colleague Fernando Silva attended the IFA trade show recently, and he said that every case company had dummy units that look and feel like the real thing, so getting hold of those isn't hard. Additionally, something about the store environment doesn't feel right to me. The display table is unreasonably small for a store, and the product labels look like they're just loosely placed, not attached. We also barely see any kind of proper store background.

Finally, while this leaker had a decent track record in the past, they've basically just been reposting Chinese social media posts lately.
